title: Forests Around Us
text:
Forests are very important for our planet. Many trees grow in a forest. Animals live there too, like birds, deer, and foxes. Forests give us clean air to breathe.

Some people walk in the forest on Sunday. They look at the trees and listen to the birds. We must help to keep forests green. We can plant new trees in our town.

questions.text: What animals live in the forest?
What do some people do in the forest on Sunday?
options: They walk and listen to the birds

questions.text: What can we infer about the people who walk in the forest?
options: They work in the forest all day

questions.text: Why does the writer say that we must help keep forests green?
options: Forests need care to stay healthy
Trees grow fully in one day

vocabulary.definition: a large area with many trees
to take air into your lungs
to put a young tree or seed into the ground
having the color of grass and leaves

paragraph_translations: Ліси дуже важливі для нашої планети. У лісі росте багато дерев. Там також живуть тварини, наприклад птахи, олені та лисиці. Ліси дають нам чисте повітря для дихання.
Деякі люди гуляють у лісі в неділю. Вони дивляться на дерева і слухають птахів. Ми повинні допомагати зберігати ліси зеленими. Ми можемо садити нові дерева в нашому місті.
